test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian artist made his debut at Cannes 2025 by showcasing a watercolour inspired by India's diversity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paresh Maity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paresh Maity** is an acclaimed Indian artist known for his mastery in **watercolour art**. He has created a plethora of artworks inspired by the rich culture and diversity of India.
 
• He made his debut at the prestigious **Cannes Film Festival in 2025**, showcasing a unique watercolour that represents the vibrant and diverse heritage of India.
 
• His work is often characterized by **vivid colors**, intricate detailing, and themes that highlight the essence of Indian traditions, landscapes, and people. *Hence, Paresh Maity is the correct answer.*
 
• The debut artwork showcased by him at Cannes 2025 reflects India’s **cultural richness**, diversity, and its harmonious blend of various traditions and practices.
 
• Paresh Maity’s contribution to the art world has been widely recognized, and his participation in Cannes underscores the importance of Indian art on the global stage. *Hence, he represents India’s artistic talent internationally.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Paresh Maity:**

 
 
• **Born in 1965**, Paresh Maity hails from West Bengal, India. He is renowned for his **watercolour paintings**, although he also works with oils, acrylics, and mixed media.
 
• He is celebrated for capturing the essence of Indian life, landscapes, and festivals in his works, often showcasing the **vibrancy and diversity of Indian culture.**
 
• Maity has received several accolades, including the **Padma Shri** award, one of the highest civilian awards in India, for his contribution to the field of art.
 
 
 
• **Cannes Film Festival:**
 
 
• The **Cannes Film Festival**, held annually in Cannes, France, is one of the most prestigious film festivals globally. It also serves as a platform to celebrate and exhibit artistic creations from various fields.
 
• The inclusion of Paresh Maity’s artwork in Cannes 2025 highlights the growing importance of Indian art and culture on an international level.
 
 
 
• **Other notable Indian artists:**
 
 
• **Jitish Kallat:** Known for his contemporary art and installations reflecting Indian history and culture.
 
• **Subodh Gupta:** Famous for his sculptures and installations that often utilize everyday objects to represent Indian lifestyle.
 
• **Anish Kapoor:** Recognized globally for his abstract sculptures and innovative use of materials.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indian artists in international platforms:**

 
 
• Indian artists, including Paresh Maity, have gained recognition for their contributions to global art platforms such as **Cannes, Venice Biennale, and Art Basel.**
 
• This representation highlights the growing appreciation of Indian art that blends traditional and contemporary elements.
 
 
 
• **Watercolour Art:**
 
 
• Watercolour is a unique medium in painting that uses pigments mixed with water to create vibrant and translucent artwork.
 
• Paresh Maity is particularly skilled in this medium, using it to represent the **subtle nuances of Indian landscapes, traditions, and emotions.**
